_comment: Ceiling on PureFIT's own median time, in milliseconds, per fixture and scenario. Absolute rather than measured against the Garmin SDK, so a release of theirs can never move our pass mark. CI runs roughly 3x slower than a local M-series Mac and varies a lot run to run: Parse measured 84.5 / 97.7 / 107.6 ms across three runs of identical code, a 27% spread. Budgets are ~1.6x the slowest observation, so they catch gross regressions rather than drift. Tighten only with more samples than that.
